name: Servants of the Night
source:
After waking up in the forest with a head injury and no memories, you follow the moonlit path to a nearby mansion. To your surprise and confusion, the three handsome butlers greet you as if they’ve been awaiting your return! Apparently, you’re the mistress of the household who disappeared some years back.

The butlers immediately begin tending to your every need, from first aid, to clothing, and even food… But instead of a meal, they bring you a goblet of blood! It turns out your butlers are vampires, and with only a month until your twentieth birthday, you’ll soon have a choice to make… Will you leave your humanity behind?

In Servants of the Night, find out whether you really need a beating heart to fall in love!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.vampirebutler]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
当你在森林中醒来时，头部受了伤，失去了记忆，你沿着月光下的小路来到了附近的一座宅邸。让你惊讶又困惑的是，三位英俊的管家迎接你，仿佛他们一直在等待你的归来！显然，你是几年前失踪的家庭女主人。

管家立即开始满足你的每一个需求，从急救，到衣服，甚至食物……但他们给你带来的不是一顿饭，而是一杯血！原来你的管家是吸血鬼，距离你二十岁生日只剩一个月了，你很快就要做出选择……你会放弃人性吗？

在《夜之仆从》中，看看你是否真的需要一颗跳动的心才能坠入爱河！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.vampirebutler]Google Play[/url]]
